svg.text: rq_evolve_4b_nr5 — 123 programs ever champion · 19 alive · 12 seed roots · 99 iterations · coverage 32%

R_Q = p̂(1-p̂)·H peaks at p̂ = 0.5 — the darkest and lightest fills are both dead niches. Label = CONCEPT_TYPE with its group prefix dropped; sparkline = p̂ per iteration while the program held its niche. Only archived champions appear; program_id is a source hash, so re-derivations from other parents collapse onto one node.
